protocol.eligibility: first original production HOT per market, separated by six hours, regardless of outcome
protocol.prediction_clock: finished_at of the matched original completed scan
protocol.surge_window: strictly after availability, at or before six hours
protocol.reference: recorded ticker last, not an executable entry
protocol.unknown: right-censored, missing terminal, or gapped path; never counted as failure or zero return
protocol.purpose: audit comparison cohort, not an entry model or validation of relaxed filters
